issue: #9 D4.11 (offline); Issue #5 MANDATORY IMPLEMENTATION GATE: parser-owned evidence tool library, not prompt-only
scope: Audit of the evidence-tool code already in the repository, what D4.11 reuses, what it does not reuse and why, and the V6 registry built from it. No model was called.

reusedUnchanged: parser line records (text, page, reading order, bbox, typography) loaded from PdfSourceEvidenceStore; the universe is rebuilt from the same object (P7F1V6Universe.Tools)
CompactLayout (bbox and font as in the request payload)
PageStats (line count, text extent, median font size)
Relation (same baseline, vertical offset, horizontal overlap, font-size delta), exposed as RelationOf without change
Bold, font size and left edge readers (exposed as FontSizeOf, LeftEdgeOf)

notReused.what: tool descriptions of get_repeated_occurrences and compare_occurrences
notReused.why: they name kinds of line to look for ("running headers/footers or contents entries vs. body headings"; "a contents entry and the body line it may refer to, or a title and the line below it"). That is a semantic hint in the tool contract; V6 descriptions say only what a tool returns. A test asserts that no V6 description names a kind of line.

targets resolve issued O# ids; the universe instance issues O1 for its first line, so results would carry an "occurrence":"O1" field that means nothing in V6. Some tools (context, span) have no truncation path and throw when over the cap instead of cutting the result.

notReused.what: text clipping at 160 characters with an appended ellipsis
notReused.why: it changes the text Qwen sees. V6 clips list results at 300 characters with explicit textTruncated and textChars and adds nothing; get_source_span returns up to 4,000 characters. The longest SRC-095 line is 103 characters, so no SRC-095 line is clipped.

reusedUnchanged: Normalize (diacritics, case and all whitespace removed) for search mode normalized

notReused.what: the instance and its result format
notReused.why: its 16 KB cap is measured on its own body; wrapping it in the V6 envelope (evidence id, provenance) could exceed the cap. V6 search applies the same matching rules and paginates on the exact V6 body.
not needed for SRC-095 (no line over 103 characters); get_source_span returns up to 4,000 characters per line with an explicit cut marker.

reusedDesign: assistant message carrying tool_calls, followed by one role tool message per call with that call's tool_call_id
tool_choice auto for a bounded number of rounds, then tool_choice none for the answer
a per-round call cap; a call over the cap is still answered (REJECTED), so every tool_call_id has a reply
mandatory-evidence arm: an answer with no successful tool call fails the contract

notReused.why: the V6 audit chain (prepared-body SHA at the HTTP boundary, safe raw store outside the repository, endpoint and model check, usage and finish audit, provider cost against the reserve, Budget.Admit before every POST, consecutive-contract-failure stop) is built on the non-streaming P7F1V6OpenRouterTransport. D4.11 extends that chain: the usage audit accepts finish_reason tool_calls only on agent turns.

auditedComponents.priorEvidence: F1Q 2026-10-09 on qwen/qwen3.7-flash via Alibaba: with tool_choice auto the tools reached the model but were called in 0/10 requests; the mandatory-evidence arm produced tool_call -> C# tool -> Qwen answer in 9/10; tool_choice required is not supported on the Alibaba route.

auditedComponents.finding: prompt-only retrieval: Qwen asks in its JSON answer and C# adds lines to the next request's context. It is not a tool route. In agent mode a NEEDS_EVIDENCE reply is refused (NEEDS_EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_AGENT_MODE); evidence comes through native tool calls.

registry.dispatch: native OpenRouter tool_calls -> C# reads name and arguments as given -> strict argument check (known keys only, all required, types, ranges, aliases of this document, 2,048-byte arguments) -> the one handler the name selects -> exact JSON body <= 16,384 bytes -> role tool message with the call's tool_call_id. A bad call is answered with status INVALID_ARGUMENT or UNKNOWN_TOOL and a code, recorded, and observes nothing.

tools.name: get_document_overview
tools.returns: line and page counts; per page line count, text extent, median font size; font-size histogram (16 most used sizes)

tools.name: get_source_context
tools.returns: lines around one line with text, page, layout and relation to it; same-baseline peers; page statistics

tools.name: get_page_layout
tools.returns: page lines with text and layout; page statistics; hasMore/nextOffset

tools.name: get_source_span
tools.returns: full parser record of each line (up to 4,000 characters of text)

tools.name: search_document_text
tools.arguments: query 2..200 chars, mode literal|normalized, offset, limit 1..50
tools.returns: matching lines of the whole document in reading order, with total and nextOffset

tools.name: get_repeated_occurrences
tools.returns: other lines with the same normalized text, with page, layout and exact-match flag; an empty key reports no repeats

tools.name: compare_source_locations
tools.returns: both lines with their windows, layout and page statistics; page distance, reading-order distance, same normalized text, same exact text, font-size, bold-ratio and left-edge differences

registry.getPageImage: NOT_REGISTERED: the V6 evidence store holds no page image and image input on the pinned route is not verified
registry.truncation: A result that would exceed 16,384 bytes is cut by whole items and says so (truncated, returned, available, nextOffset); text is never shortened silently.
registry.labels: No result carries a heading, contents or role label; provenance says semanticLabels NONE.
registry.ledger: Every call is recorded: evidence id, tool, SHA-256 of the raw arguments, status, error code, content SHA-256 and bytes, truncated flag, aliases shown.

agentLoop.answer: arm B object reply (P7_F1_V6_SELECT_OBJECTS_V1), strict parser unchanged; no version field in the payload
agentLoop.turns: 1..3 tool_choice auto; 4 tool_choice none; a tool call on turn 4 fails (TOOL_CALL_AFTER_TOOL_CAP)
agentLoop.withoutTools: allowed in arm AUTO (Issue #9: the data shown may be enough); refused in the diagnostic arm EVIDENCE_FIRST
agentLoop.noUnobservedClaims: evidenceRefs must be aliases Qwen saw in the request or in a successful tool result; any other alias is refused (EVIDENCE_NOT_SHOWN)
agentLoop.scopes: evaluated (the unit's targets), observed (request lines plus tool-shown lines, with pages), whole document (all lines; observed in full or not) are reported separately; refs to lines seen only through tools are counted
neverDone: adding a call Qwen did not make
any rule about which lines to select

openItems: The non-streaming tool_calls response shape of the Alibaba route has not been observed yet (F1Q used streaming). The canary is the first observation.
json_object together with tools was used by F1Q plan V3 on this route; whether json_object changes how often Qwen calls tools is unknown.
Assistant turns are sent back without their reasoning text. Whether Qwen 3.7 Flash expects its reasoning between tool turns is not documented.
Reasoning tokens are billed on every turn, tool turns included; the reserve covers max_tokens on every POST.
